# Maison et jardins de Claude Monet – Giverny

> > Official site for Claude Monet's house and gardens in Giverny, featuring the iconic water lilies garden, Japanese water garden, and Clos Normand.

The Fondation Monet manages this historic estate in Normandy where Impressionist master Claude Monet lived and painted from 1883 to 1926. Visitors can explore the restored house, the famous Nymphéas (water lilies) pond, and seasonal flower gardens that inspired his masterpieces.

## Key Topics

- Claude Monet
- Giverny
- Nymphéas (Water Lilies)
- Le Jardin d'Eau (Japanese Water Garden)
- Le Clos Normand (Flower Garden)
- Impressionism
- Fondation Monet
- Normandie
- Musée de l'Orangerie
- Monet Gardens
- Giverny Flowers
- Water Lilies Studio
- Latour-Marliac
- Normandie Impressionniste

## Gardens & Estate

- [Nymphéas – Water Lilies Garden](https://claudemonetgiverny.fr/decouvrir/les-fleurs-de-giverny/nympheas): Water lilies in Monet's Japanese garden at Giverny with seasonal info
- [L'atelier des nymphéas – Water Lilies Studio](https://claudemonetgiverny.fr/decouvrir/latelier-des-nympheas): Water lilies studio gift shop and boutique at Monet's Giverny estate

- [Ressources – Visitor Resources](https://claudemonetgiverny.fr/ressources): Visitor info, group tours, rates, reservations, and press resources

## News & Exhibitions

- [Et la couleur vint aux nymphéas – History of Colored Water Lilies](https://claudemonetgiverny.fr/actualites/et-la-couleur-vint-aux-nympheas): History of colored water lilies by Latour-Marliac from Temple-sur-Lot
- [1915 : Sacha Guitry Films Claude Monet](https://claudemonetgiverny.fr/actualites/1915-sacha-guitry-cinematographie-claude-monet): Historic 1915 film footage of Monet by director Sacha Guitry
- [Claude Monet au format XXL](https://claudemonetgiverny.fr/actualites/claude-monet-au-format-xxl): Yadegar Asisi's XXL panorama exhibition in Rouen Cathedral
- [Inspirante Riviera – Monet on the French Riviera](https://claudemonetgiverny.fr/actualites/inspirante-riviera): Monet's Riviera exhibition at Grimaldi Forum Monaco, 1880s paintings
- [Dans les coulisses des plantations (2)](https://claudemonetgiverny.fr/actualites/dans-les-coulisses-des-plantations-2): Behind-the-scenes planting tutorial by head gardener Rémi Lecoutre
